title: Okapi: Generalising Better by Making Statistical Matches Match

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy across 8 demographic identity dimensions (spanning different genders, religions, and ethnicities) on the CivilComments toxicity classification dataset.
Evaluating worst-group Pearson correlation and mean squared error across urban versus rural sub-populations on the PovertyMap satellite imagery dataset.
Evaluating out-of-distribution generalisation (macro-F1 score) across different, unseen camera trap locations with varying illumination and background conditions on the iWildCam dataset.
